# ThaiPlot
> Thailand's independent marketplace — land, property, vehicles and more

ThaiPlot.com connects international buyers with verified listings
across Thailand: land & property, vehicles, boats, businesses and
other items. Listed by owners and agents.

## What we offer
- Land for sale with Chanote title deeds
- Villas, condos and commercial property
- Vehicles, boats and businesses
- Free listing for owners and agents
- Title deed verification tool at data.hua-hin-land.com
- Guides on buying property in Thailand as a foreigner

## Our agent

## Key locations
Hua Hin, Pranburi, Sam Roi Yod, Prachuap Khiri Khan, Phuket
